description: Defines the ArtifactDispatcher class for managing artifact operations such as saving, streaming, and deleting artifacts within the Playwright testing framework. Implements channels for communication and interacts with filesystem utilities.

classes.name: ArtifactDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class for handling artifact-related operations such as saving, streaming, failure reporting, cancellation, and deletion within the Playwright framework.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Creates an ArtifactDispatcher instance from a parent scope and artifact.

methods.name: fromNullable
methods.description: Creates an ArtifactDispatcher if artifact is not null, otherwise returns undefined.

methods.name: pathAfterFinished
methods.description: Retrieves the path of the artifact after it has finished processing.

methods.name: saveAs
methods.description: Saves the artifact to a specified path.

methods.name: saveAsStream
methods.description: Provides a stream to save the artifact data.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Retrieves failure error information for the artifact.
